text:
*The Temple of the Ashen God is the oldest building in Ashenmoor — a cathedral of dark stone with windows of colored glass that cast strange patterns across the stone floor. The air smells of incense and old books.*

*Brother Orin tends the altar candles — a gaunt man in grey robes, his tonsured head gleaming in the candlelight. He looks up at your approach with eyes that have seen too much.*

Orin: "A seeker in troubled times. The Ashen God teaches that from ruin comes renewal — but I confess, I see mostly ruin these days."

*He gestures to the nearly empty pews.*

Orin: "People are afraid to gather. Three of our own congregation have vanished — merchants all. And last week, I heard a confession that... troubles me. I cannot share the words, but I can tell you this: the evil in this city wears a respectable face."

*He pauses, choosing his next words carefully.*

Orin: "I also serve as the temple's herbalist. I've examined a sample from the Duke's household — brought to me in secret. What I found was nightbloom extract. A slow poison. Undetectable in wine."

choices.text: "Can you prove it's poison? We need evidence."
